priorityList: Use Combat Potions, Trinkets, and Racial abilities (like Blood Fury or Berserking) during your opening sequence and burst windows.
Use Black Ox Brew if you have less than 1 charge of Celestial Brew or if you are low on Energy.
Cast Celestial Brew when the Aspect of Harmony: Spender buff is active, unless the Empty Barrel buff is also active.
Prioritize Keg Smash when both Aspect of Harmony: Spender and Empty Barrel buffs are active simultaneously.
While Invoke Niuzao is active, prioritize Breath of Fire and Keg Smash to benefit from Wisdom of the Wall.
Use Blackout Kick to maintain the Blackout Combo buff or whenever it is off cooldown.
Cast Purifying Brew and Fortifying Brew to manage Stagger, ideally avoiding usage during Empty Barrel procs.
Cast Chi Burst on cooldown for additional damage.
Invoke Niuzao the Black Ox on cooldown for major damage and damage reduction.
Use Exploding Keg if Keg Smash has no charges available.
Cast Empty the Cellar when Celestial Brew has more than 15 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Use Keg Smash to prevent charges from capping or to trigger Scalding Brew and Flurry Strikes procs.
Cast Breath of Fire when Blackout Kick is on cooldown or to refresh your damage reduction.
Use Tiger Palm when Blackout Combo is active or when your Energy is high (above 65) to avoid capping.
Maintain Rushing Jade Wind for consistent damage and use Expel Harm as a low-priority filler or for healing.
